chapter: The Paradise and life in Queens
title: Friends who visited the Nicholas home
summary: Her family, Denzil Best, Budd Johnson (whose wife sold them the house), Timmie Kennedy, Jimmy Jones and others visited; he and Al McKibbon shared bands.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: As friends that you had, friends that would spend time at your house...musicians or non-musicians?

Well, my friends... well mostly it was her family. She had a big family, they'd come by, you know; some of them even stayed there for a little while, different ones. But the musicians, Denzil Best used to come by; Budd Johnson used to come by all the time 'cause he lived out there. In fact, his wife was a real estate agent and she...they sold us our house. And Timmie Kennedy...he's in that Ebony magazine... they didn't list his name, but he's sittin' down
there when 'Cherry Red' is dancin'. And, let's see who else, Jimmy Nottingham used to come by and Jimmy Jones was there all the time and Joe Newman and Al McKibbon, you know. J.C. Heard, you know.
You and Al McKibbon were in quite a few bands together, weren't you?

Dizzy and J.C. Heard. He's with Sammy Davis now. I called J.C. about two or three months ago and he said he's been with Sammy Davis for five years, so that means he's workin' steady. (laughter) Sammy works all the time.
